Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 12  
Reason for Mistake: This step marks the exit of the loop (Rule 1) where the WebServing_Expert prematurely directs the user to manually check the GitHub releases page without verifying if it contains the required contributor list. This creates a data issue by assuming the list is accessible (Rule 2) and leads to irrecoverable consequences as subsequent steps rely on this unverified assumption (Rule 3).
